cautionOverrides.from: The Spanish Master 4 source contrasts ser and estar. French has no such grammatical split; a role/state distinction comes from the predicate and context. Future forms in the dialogue should be checked for prerequisite load.
cautionOverrides.to: French uses the predicate and context to distinguish an ongoing role from temporary availability. Confirm who can take the meeting today before assigning tasks.

explanationOverrides.from: French être can describe a role, identity, condition or availability; it does not split these functions into two verbs like Spanish ser/estar. Add context and time markers to distinguish a durable assignment (Maya est responsable de la réunion) from a temporary state (elle ne se sent pas bien aujourd’hui). Use qui to ask who is responsible and quand or à quelle heure to check availability. Restate the two confirmed facts separately.
